evidence: eval_script.py invocation: python3 eval_script.py; no CLI args.

eval_script.py loads test_windows_truth.json (77 hidden weekly windows over 2025Q1-2026H1) and test_fomc_events.json (12 hidden FOMC events with true rate decisions), invokes /home/workspace/fed_funds_positioning.py --backtest against the input_dir it prepares from hidden CSVs + agent-visible schedule, parses positioning_results.json, per-window recomputes regime accuracy + 2Y/10Y MAE + duration/slope PnL Sharpe + carry PnL sum, aggregates cross-cadence stability across 6-month buckets, emits TOTAL_SCORE <N> on stdout.

score.py implements 8 per-lane scoring functions with anchors capped at rates-frontier values per PKW-FAMILIES section 3 Framework B (regime accuracy floor 0.60, 2Y MAE floor 5bps ceiling 50bps, 10Y MAE floor 8bps ceiling 80bps, duration/slope Sharpe cap 2.0, carry sum floor -2.0 ceiling +2.0).
positioning_results.json is generated by the submitted fed_funds_positioning.py at judge time, so it is not listed as a required submission file.
test_windows_truth.json + test_fomc_events.json + true_regime_events.json are hidden scoring label files used only by eval_script.py + score.py.
warnings: The expert scorer assumes hidden scoring data files are copied from /home/workspace/scoring/ into /home/workspace/ before invocation; agent-visible schedule + hidden truth are separated so the agent NEVER sees realized next-week yields or realized regime labels.
Validation failures inside eval_script.py that fail before emitting TOTAL_SCORE will produce parse_failure and zero out per the failure_policy.
